## What happens (from the parent, item 6)

Source: the 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`), zh-CN.

- **Reach:** the case actions 升级工单, 关闭工单 and 认领工单 show 「流程「升级工单」已完成」 and so on. Measured 3 of 3.
- Script actions such as 记录通话 do show their own `successMessage` (「通话记录成功！」).

## Acceptance

An action-door flow launch shows the action's declared `successMessage` when one is set. Without one, the existing flow-completed toast stays.
